resources.string: Why a separate voice engine? CuevaReader is built only with free and open source software. We believe in software freedom: you can use, study, share and improve every part of it, and nobody pays royalties or license fees to anyone. Many apps could be built this way with little effort, but most don\'t. We hope this encourages you to prefer, and build, open alternatives too.
CuevaReader reads books aloud using a free, open source text-to-speech engine. It is not bundled with the app, so please install one of these first:

1. Tap "Download" next to an engine. Its F-Droid page opens in your browser.
2. Scroll down and tap "Download APK" on the latest version (or install it through the F-Droid app if you have it).
3. Open the downloaded file from the notification or your Downloads folder.
4. If Android asks, allow your browser to "Install unknown apps", then go back and tap Install.
5. Open the engine app once and download a voice for your language (SherpaTTS and RHVoice need this).
6. Come back to CuevaReader and tap the button below.
If you prefer, you can use Google\'s engine on your phone:
Google Speech Services is not installed on this phone.

Thousands of books are free to read and share, legally. Projects like Project Gutenberg, run by volunteers, digitize public domain works (classics whose copyright has expired) and offer them at no cost, with no accounts and no DRM.

Other great sources are Standard Ebooks and Wikisource.

To add a book:
1. Download it in EPUB format (on Project Gutenberg choose "EPUB3").
2. Move the .epub file into your library folder (for example Reader).
3. Open this panel again and tap the book.
If buying isn\'t owning, pirating is not stealing.\nPlease pirate your books.
No EPUB files here yet. Copy .epub files into this folder and reopen this panel.

CuevaReader lists the EPUB books stored in a folder of your choice. We suggest a folder called "Reader" in your internal storage.

In the next screen:
1. If you are not in the internal storage root, open the menu (☰) and pick your phone's storage.
2. Tap ⋮ and choose "New folder", name it Reader (skip this if it already exists).
3. Open the Reader folder and tap "Use this folder", then "Allow".

You can change the folder later from the Library panel.
